company.shortDescription: OneGCC is an employment platform, focused on matching Job Seekers with Job opportunities based on their skills and personalities.
company.description: OneGCC is an employment platform, focused on matching Job Seekers with Job Opportunities based on their skills and personalities. They solve the problem of unemployment with a skill matching solution that leverages smart hiring algorithms, social learning and gamified assessments. Primarily supporting the nationalization of jobs across countries in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), OneGCC is the only dedicated talent platform for GCC nationals that simplifies the approach of hiring qualified GCC nationals into the region's workforce.
